items.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
items.dek: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.

items.title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
items.dek: Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.
